Admin routes of the audit log module. Every route needs a staff session and the permission named on it; send `X-Resolve-Locale: false` to receive every locale of a translatable field for editing.

## GET /v1/admin/audit-log

Search audit log entries

Parameters:

- `action` in query (string, optional).
- `actor` in query (string, max length 120, optional).
- `entityType` in query (string, optional).
- `from` in query (string, optional).
- `page` in query (number, min 1, optional).
- `pageSize` in query (number, min 1, max 100, optional).
- `to` in query (string, optional).
- `userId` in query (string, optional).

Responses:

- `200`: no description.

## GET /v1/admin/audit-log/{entityType}/{entityId}

List audit log entries for one entity

Parameters:

- `entityId` in path (string, required).
- `entityType` in path (string, required).
- `action` in query (string, optional).
- `actor` in query (string, max length 120, optional).
- `entityType` in query (string, optional).
- `from` in query (string, optional).
- `page` in query (number, min 1, optional).
- `pageSize` in query (number, min 1, max 100, optional).
- `to` in query (string, optional).
- `userId` in query (string, optional).

Responses:

- `200`: no description.
